papers.title_en: LVSPM: Long Sequence View Synthesis and Pose Estimation Model
papers.authors: Xi Chen, Yachi Zhang, Linghao Chen, Minghua Liu, Hao Su, Zexiang Xu, Xiaoshuai Zhang
papers.evidence: 从未标定图像联合估计相机位姿并生成新视图，且超过VGGT的位姿表现
papers.tldr: 从未标定图像集合中同时恢复相机位姿并合成新视角，要求模型无需稠密三维真值，还能处理大量视图和不断扩大的场景。LVSPM仅以RGB图像和位姿监督训练，并引入测试时训练层，使输入规模可扩展至数百张图像。在RealEstate10k、Co3Dv2和DL3DV上，其16至256视图的位姿估计优于VGGT；按更多视图覆盖更大场景的实用协议评测时，合成质量超过依赖位姿的方法，且场景扩大后仍保持较高质量。该工作展示了长序列位姿估计与视图合成统一建模的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: We present LVSPM, a generalizable model that jointly estimates camera poses and synthesizes novel views from uncalibrated image collections. Trained with only RGB images and pose supervision, LVSPM avoids dense 3D ground truth and employs test-time training (TTT) layers to scale seamlessly to hundreds of input views. On RealEstate10k, Co3Dv2, and DL3DV, LVSPM surpasses VGGT in pose estimation across 16-256 views, with especially large margins at strict thresholds. For novel view synthesis under a practical protocol where more views cover larger scenes, LVSPM achieves state-of-the-art pose-free quality---surpassing even pose-dependent models in PSNR---and still maintains high quality as scene scale grows, while baselines collapse. The code is available at https://burningdust21.github.io/Projects/LVSPM .

papers.title_en: RGBD-to-3D Object Mesh Refinement via Depth Matching and Symmetry Propagation
papers.authors: Ahyun Seo, Minsu Cho
papers.evidence: 通过深度匹配与对称传播直接修正重建网格
papers.tldr: 单视图三维重建结果虽常看似合理，却可能在深度突变和自遮挡处偏离输入视图，影响几何准确性。本文提出免训练、可插拔的RGBD细化方法：匹配可见表面与深度反投影点，将修正沿检测到的对称面传播至遮挡侧，并以平滑求解器补全。各步骤均为闭式计算，速度远快于依赖优化的测试时细化。在GSO、OmniObject3D的五种骨干上均获稳定提升，伪深度和带噪真实深度下也有效。该方法兼顾精度与效率，可通用增强重建器。
papers.abstract_en: Single-view 3D reconstructors often produce plausible meshes that disagree with the input view, especially near depth discontinuities and self-occlusions. We present a lightweight, plug-and-play RGBD-to-3D refinement that improves any RGB-to-3D reconstructor without retraining. Given a depth map, we correct the visible surface by bipartite matching to back-projected depth points, mirror these corrections onto the occluded side across a detected symmetry plane, and propagate them with a smoothness solver. Every stage is closed-form, making the method orders of magnitude faster than optimization-heavy test-time refinement. On GSO and OmniObject3D with five backbones, it yields consistent gains, also with monocular pseudo-depth, benefits more from symmetry on symmetric objects, and compares favorably with prior refinement in accuracy and runtime. It further improves an RGB-D-to-mesh reconstructor and transfers to real captures with noisy sensor depth.

papers.title_en: Zebra3D: Efficient Hybrid Foundation Models For Scalable 3D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Utkarsh Saxena, Ruijing Yang, Mehdi Rezagholizadeh, Akash Haridas, Vikram Appia, Emad Barsoum
papers.evidence: 针对VGGT等前馈三维重建基础模型优化注意力计算
papers.tldr: 从未标定图像重建三维场景的基础模型依赖全局注意力，视角数量增多会带来二次增长的计算成本，限制大规模输入。Zebra3D按网络层的注意力敏感度，组合线性中心注意力与分块稀疏注意力，并用地标摘要保留未选上下文，可免训练转换，也支持后续监督与特征蒸馏。该方法适用于 VGGT、HunyuanWorld-Mirror 和 π³；视角数达 1024 时端到端加速最高 7.1 倍，训练后 VGGT 在 94% 平均稀疏度下取得 80.5% 的 RealEstate10K AUC@30。结果表明，利用层间差异可显著降低注意力开销，同时使重建与相机位姿精度接近稠密模型。
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D foundation models reconstruct scenes from unposed images, but the quadratic cost of global attention limits their scalability to large view sets. We present Zebra3D, a layerwise sparse-linear hybrid attention framework that improves the efficiency of pretrained 3D foundation models without training from scratch. Across VGGT, HunyuanWorld-Mirror, and $π^3$, we observe a broadly consistent depth-wise pattern: early stages are relatively tolerant to linear replacement, while sensitive middle-to-late stages tend to exhibit more concentrated attention. Zebra3D exploits this structure by assigning linear-centered attention to tolerant stages and tile-sparse attention to sensitive stages, using landmark summaries to preserve unselected context. Closed-form affine fitting enables training-free conversion, while optional post-conversion training combines task supervision with output and relational feature distillation. Across all three backbones, Zebra3D achieves strong reconstruction and camera-pose accuracy at high attention sparsity, with training-free variants remaining close to their dense counterparts. End-to-end speedups increase with input view count, reaching up to $7.1\times$ at 1,024 views. After post-conversion training, Zebra3D-VGGT reaches 80.5\% RealEstate10K AUC@30 at 94\% mean attention sparsity, within 1.1 percentage points of dense VGGT fine-tuned on the same data and schedule.

papers.title_en: PURE: Refining Feed-forward 3D Reconstruction with Unlabeled Post-training
papers.authors: Yaolong Zhu, Peng Li, Jiahao Lu, Chengfeng Zhao, Mengfei Li, Chao Wang, Wenyue Chen, Zekai Gu, Chengwei Ren, Ronggang Wang, Yuan Liu
papers.evidence: 无标注后训练改进前馈三维重建的深度和相机估计
papers.tldr: 前馈式三维重建受益于大规模训练和强学习先验，但在真实动态视频中仍易受非刚性运动、遮挡与光照变化干扰。模型依赖昂贵的深度和相机位姿标注，限制了多样真实数据的扩展及跨域泛化。PURE提出无标签后训练框架，将二维先验的结构知识迁移至四维前馈架构，结合相对深度约束、不变几何蒸馏和基于特征对应的位姿优化。合成与真实动态基准实验表明，该方法持续提升多种先进架构并缓解域偏移，为复杂野外场景中的几何估计提供数据高效的改进方案。
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models have achieved remarkable progress through large-scale training and strong learned priors. However, they remain fragile when applied to dynamic in-the-wild videos, where non-rigid motion, occlusions, and illumination changes are prevalent. A key limitation lies in their reliance on expensive depth and camera pose annotations, which hinders scaling to diverse real-world dynamic data and restricts generalization. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{PURE}, an unlabeled post-training refinement framework that improves depth and camera estimation without requiring ground-truth supervision. Instead of relying on annotations, PURE elegantly distills robust structural knowledge from state-of-the-art 2D priors into 4D feed-forward architectures. PURE leverages relative depth constraints, affine-invariant geometry distillation, and pose refinement based on feature correspondences to stabilize geometric predictions under challenging dynamic conditions. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world dynamic benchmarks demonstrate that PURE delivers consistent improvements across multiple state-of-the-art architectures. Furthermore, our data-efficient paradigm effectively mitigates domain shifts, successfully unlocking the architectural limits of these base models in challenging, in-the-wild dynamic scenes.

papers.title_en: Geometry-Guided Semantic Reconstruction for 3D Instance Segmentation
papers.authors: Yuanhao Su, Shaofeng Zhang
papers.evidence: 直接研究三维实例分割及二维到三维语义重建
papers.tldr: 三维实例分割既需要可靠的几何结构，也依赖强区分性的语义；纯三维编码器语义能力有限，直接拼接二维先验又可能与三维结构错位。本文将二维到三维的语义迁移建模为掩码语义重建，并在编码前用原始三维几何调制二维语义特征。前者为三维编码器提供恢复缺失语义先验的显式监督，后者缓解二维与三维特征的分布差异。在 ScanNetV2、ScanNet200 的两种基线框架上，方法于全数据和少样本设置均取得当前最佳结果，为融合几何与语义提供了有效方案。
papers.abstract_en: 3D instance segmentation requires representations that are both geometrically structured and semantically discriminative. Pure 3D encoders model spatial structure well but often lack strong appearance semantics, while directly lifting 2D priors into 3D by concatenation injects rich semantics without ensuring that they align well with the underlying 3D structure. In this paper, we address this problem by formulating 2D-to-3D semantic transfer as a \textbf{masked semantic reconstruction} task. Specifically, we mask a subset of background lifted 2D priors and train the 3D encoder to recover the missing semantic priors, providing explicit supervision for distilling rich 2D semantics into the 3D backbone. We further propose \textbf{geometry-modulated semantic injection}, which uses raw 3D geometry to modulate lifted 2D priors before sparse encoding, so that geometry explicitly controls semantic injection and alleviates the distribution gap between 2D semantic features and 3D geometric features. Experiments on two baseline frameworks demonstrate that the proposed method achieves state-of-the-art results in both full-data and few-shot settings on ScanNetV2 and ScanNet200. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/yharoldsu0627/Geometry_Guided_Semantic_Reconstruction

papers.title_en: DIGS: Distribution-Informed Gaussian Splatting for Training-Free Open-Vocabulary 3D Segmentation
papers.authors: Zhifan Zeng, Wenbo Xiao, Arcot Sowmya, Changming Sun
papers.evidence: 训练免调的开放词汇三维高斯场景分割
papers.tldr: 开放词汇三维分割常需逐场景训练，且单一语义特征难以处理跨实例边界高斯，造成检索精度下降和掩码边界不稳。DIGS无需训练，先以温度化狄利克雷规则保留每个高斯的多峰标签分布，并构建类别无关实例本体；再融合实例视觉特征与语言模型生成描述的文本特征。LERF-OVS平均mIoU达71.95%，并在LERF-Mask、3D-OVS和Replica上取得领先或有竞争力的结果。该方法单场景映射与编码仅需1.0至3.2分钟，原生三维查询耗时5.4毫秒，为快速、边界友好的开放词汇三维分割提供了免训练方案。
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary 3D Gaussian segmentation typically binds semantic features to the per-Gaussian state via per-scene gradient training (1-4 h) or the more recent closed-form distillation. Both commit each primitive to a single feature; therefore, boundary Gaussians spanning multiple 2D instances are forced into a hard decision that degrades retrieval accuracy and yields unstable mask boundaries at render time. We present DIGS, a training-free framework with two stages, class-agnostic mapping and multi-modal encoding, that decouples instance discovery from linguistic naming. At the Gaussian level, our distribution-informed representation maintains an explicit top-$M$ label distribution per primitive, updated by a tempered Dirichlet rule; preservation of multi-peaked label distributions at boundary primitives allows a late-argmax renderer to recover clean instance boundaries. A bidirectional state machine aggregates these distributions into a persistent class-agnostic instance ontology. The instance-level encoding stage then fuses the CLIP visual embedding of each instance's isolated 3D footprint with the CLIP-text embedding of an LLM-generated attribute description, disambiguating visually similar instances. On a single A100, DIGS completes mapping and instance encoding on LERF-OVS in 1.0-3.2 min per scene, depending on whether LLM fusion is enabled, and serves native 3D queries in 5.4 ms. It reaches 71.95% mean mIoU on LERF-OVS, outperforming both the training-free SFS and training-based LaGa baselines. DIGS also achieves the highest mean mIoU on LERF-Mask and 3D-OVS and surpasses Gaga and ObjectGS on Replica under their respective evaluation protocols. Code is available at https://github.com/ZephyrZos/DIGS.

papers.title_en: Graph3R: Unifying View Graph Initialization with Feed-Forward Reconstruction
papers.authors: Jingwen Yu, Hengli Wang, Jianhao Jiao, Zhonghang Liu, Ping Tan, Hong Zhang
papers.evidence: 联合视图图初始化与前馈重建，处理相机位姿和稠密几何
papers.tldr: 未经整理的图像集合常包含多个互不相连的场景，若将其作为单一场景联合重建，容易破坏相机姿态与几何；传统方法又把视图关联和重建分阶段处理，二者衔接不足。Graph3R复用π³多视图特征预测成对共视关系，构建视图图并划分场景，再对各组特征进行屏蔽后分别解码姿态和稠密几何。三个基准上，百分之百精度下平均最大召回率较基线最高提升8.99个百分点，混合场景重建质量也更好；多会话任务中查询组重建约快35.9倍。该方法推动视图关联与几何推理统一，为未经整理图像集合的端到端重建提供方案。
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward reconstruction recovers camera poses and dense geometry from image sets whose views are assumed to come from a single scene. In practice, uncurated image collections often contain views from disjoint scenes, and reconstructing these views jointly can corrupt camera poses and geometry. Existing pipelines typically resolve view associations in separate stages before final reconstruction, leaving view graph initialization and reconstruction inference only loosely coupled. We introduce Graph3R, which unifies view graph initialization with feed-forward reconstruction through a shared geometric representation. A lightweight verification head predicts pairwise covisibility from the multi-view features of $π^3$ to construct a view graph. This graph classifies the input views into scene groups. For each group, we mask the shared features before decoding camera poses and dense geometry. Reusing the multi-view features allows Graph3R to reconstruct disjoint scenes separately with a single backbone pass. Across three benchmarks, Graph3R improves average maximum recall at 100% precision by upto 8.99 percentage points over the baseline, while improving reconstruction quality on mixed-scene inputs. Regarding the multi-session mapping task, Graph3R improves cross-session localization and achieves competitive pose estimation accuracy, while delivering a runtime speedup of approximately $35.9\times$ over the baseline when reconstructing the query group. By integrating learned view association with geometric inference, our approach takes a step toward end-to-end reconstruction from uncurated image collections.

papers.title_en: BAT3R: Robust Online 3D Reconstruction with Bayesian Adaptive State Updates
papers.authors: Lijian Li, Yuanpeng He, Yudian Zheng, Chung-ju Huang, Linyu Li, Dongming Jin, Wenpin Jiao, Zhi Jin, Chi-Man Pun
papers.evidence: 针对前馈变换器的长序列三维重建提出在线状态更新改进
papers.tldr: 在线三维重建需逐帧处理，以避免前馈变换器在长视频上的二次复杂度；但循环架构常因未考虑观测可靠性和历史状态置信度而逐步漂移、累积误差。BAT3R提出无需训练的贝叶斯自适应框架：状态创新门控将状态演化锚定于几何初始化，贝叶斯引导更新则融合当前观测与历史状态。它结合信息论增益和交叉注意力，保护已稳定区域并积极纳入新场景内容。在多个标准基准上，BAT3R优于现有在线方法，长序列和复杂场景提升尤为明显，增强了长期重建的鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward transformer models have driven remarkable progress in 3D vision,yet their quadratic complexity renders them impractical for long video sequences. Streaming 3D reconstruction addresses this bottleneck by processing frames sequen?tially with constant memory. However, existing recurrent architectures inevitably suffer from progressive degradation over long sequences, as they fail to account for the intrinsic reliability of observations and the accumulated confidence of the historical state, leading to severe error accumulation. To address these issues, we introduce BAT3R, a training-free Bayesian adaptation framework comprising two synergistic modules: State Innovation Gating (SIG) and Bayesian-guided Adaptive State Updating (BASU). SIG acts as a distributional regularizer that anchors state evolution to its geometric initialization, effectively arresting representational drift during long-term inference. Building on this, BASU reformulates state update as a recursive Bayesian inference process within a Kalman filtering framework. By jointly modeling the temporal reliability of observations via information-theoretic gain and spatial relevance via cross-attention maps, BASU achieves an asymmetric spatio-temporal state fusion: well-consolidated historical regions are protected from redundant updates, while genuinely novel scene content is aggressively incor?porated. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks (7-Scenes, TUM, ScanNet, KITTI, etc.) demonstrate that BAT3R consistently outperforms state-of-the-art online 3D reconstruction methods, with the most significant gains observed on long sequences and complex scenes.

papers.title_en: Physical-Field-Bridged Material Parameter Inference from Multi-View Deformation Videos
papers.authors: Linrui Shou, Jie Li, Yu Liu, Tao Huang
papers.evidence: 由多视角变形视频推断材料类别与连续物理参数
papers.tldr: 从多视角形变视频中估计可用于仿真的材料参数很重要，但材料性质只能由物体受力后的响应间接揭示，单靠外观容易误判。本文提出单次前向推理框架，先预测接触与受力掩码、运动流场和应力响应图，再以这些稠密物理场辅助材料类型分类与连续参数回归。在包含5000次仿真、100种形状和五类载荷的基准上，方法在四项参数中位误差上均表现最佳，应力热点召回率达到0.5121。结果表明物理场桥接有助于快速推断和未见物体仿真重放，但跨仿真器迁移及真实场景中的域差异与可辨识性仍有限。
papers.abstract_en: Estimating simulation-ready material parameters from visual observations is crucial for deformable-object manipulation but challenging because material properties are only indirectly revealed through physical responses. We introduce physical-field-bridged material inference, a single-pass framework that uses dense physical responses to connect multi-view RGB deformation videos with constitutive-type classification and continuous parameter regression. Unlike inverse-physics methods requiring per-scene reconstruction, online tuning, or simulation-in-the-loop optimization, our model predicts force/contact masks, projected motion-flow fields, and projected stress-response maps, then conditions material inference on these fields to reduce reliance on appearance or category shortcuts. We construct DeformFieldBench, a 3DGS MPM learning environment comprising 5,000 simulations across 100 object shapes and five mechanically informative loading modes, with dense pixel-aligned physical supervision. Our method achieves the best median errors on all four continuous parameters, improves stress-hotspot recall from 0.0762 to 0.5121, and attains 0.8676 SSIM/36.82 dB PSNR in same-simulator replay on unseen objects. Under a protocol-matched GSO evaluation, inference and future-state prediction take approximately 30 seconds, compared with 15-120 minutes for per-scene optimization. The method also yields measurable replay agreement on five real-world sequences. These results support dense physical fields as an effective bridge for fast material inference, while cross-simulator and real-world tests reveal remaining domain and identifiability gaps.

papers.title_en: OpenDepth: Repurposing Image Editing Priors for Robust Open-World Monocular Depth Estimation
papers.authors: Mengke Zhang, Tianyi Yang, Xinzhuo Li, Anlong Ming
papers.evidence: 面向开放环境单目深度估计的几何推断
papers.tldr: 单目深度估计借助生成先验已取得进展，但基于文本到图像模型的方法遇到光照变化、恶劣天气等开放环境扰动时，常混淆几何与外观并产生结构幻觉。OpenDepth将问题建模为跨风格图像的一致几何推断，利用图像到图像模型的结构保持编辑先验，并对齐扩散变换器浅层特征。它还通过联合RGB潜变量重建，促使模型从退化输入恢复干净图像信息，削弱环境风格干扰。评测显示其在标准和极端天气基准的稳健零样本深度估计中刷新最佳表现，为开放世界应用提供更可靠的结构推断。
papers.abstract_en: Recently, the integration of generative priors has revolutionized Monocular Depth Estimation (MDE), achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance with remarkably high data efficiency. However, although methods based on Text-to-Image (T2I) models excel in general scenes, their efficacy degrades sharply when confronted with open-world environmental perturbations, such as illumination variations and adverse weather. Since T2I priors are optimized for semantic synthesis rather than preserving pixel-level structure, they struggle to decouple geometry from appearance under severe visual shifts, easily triggering structural hallucinations. Therefore, our core insight is to model open-world depth estimation as consistent geometric inference across multi-style images, fully leveraging the powerful structure-preserving editing priors of Image-to-Image (I2I) models. Based on this, we propose OpenDepth, a robust open-world MDE framework that introduces "Intra-Domain Awareness" -- the capability to map diverse stylistic inputs sharing identical geometry into a unified latent space. To achieve this, we first align shallow features within the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) to anchor degraded observations to unified geometric representations. Additionally, we introduce a joint RGB latent reconstruction task, requiring the model to recover clean RGB information from degraded inputs. This multi-stage strategy effectively decouples environmental style interference, compelling the model to focus strictly on underlying geometric recovery. Extensive evaluations show that OpenDepth sets new SOTA records for robust zero-shot depth estimation across standard and extreme weather benchmarks, demonstrating exceptional structural integrity and adaptability.

papers.title_en: Surface Reconstruction from Range Scans Under Visibility Constraints
papers.authors: Gabriel Lenain, Edmond Boyer, Jean Ponce
papers.evidence: 从测距扫描学习隐式表面，并利用可见性约束处理噪声与离群点。
papers.tldr: 范围扫描重建需在贴合观测与抵抗噪声、离群值之间取得平衡，而许多神经方法舍弃传感器位置及射线可见性。本文直接拟合每条采集射线上的预测首个表面交点与实测深度，并惩罚传感器和观测点之间出现的预测交点。方法以一利普希茨多层感知机表示零水平集，通过球面追踪求首交点，并采用胡伯损失，无需法向、离面采样点或艾科纳尔损失。实验表明其在干净数据上表现有竞争力，在噪声和离群值污染下更稳健；模型容量存在保真度与鲁棒性的权衡。
papers.abstract_en: Surface reconstruction from range scans is challenging in the presence of noise and outliers, as fidelity to observations must be balanced against sensitivity to measurement errors. Yet, most neural approaches discard the sensor positions and corresponding visibility information, compensating for this loss with geometric priors or regularization terms. We instead formulate surface reconstruction as robust regression of the predicted first surface intersection along each acquisition ray against its measured depth, which penalizes predicted surface intersections within the segment between the sensor and the observed point. We represent the surface as the zero set of a 1-Lipschitz multi-layer perceptron, allowing the use of linearly convergent sphere tracing to compute the first hit, and use a robust Huber loss for regression. Our formulation requires neither oriented normals, sampled off-surface points, nor an eikonal loss. Comparisons with the state of the art on synthetic and real data with varying levels of noise and outlier contamination demonstrate competitive performance on clean data and much improved fidelity and robustness under even moderate corruption. Our analysis further confirms a trade-off between fidelity and robustness: greater fitting capacity improves data fidelity in the clean case but increases sensitivity to the measurement errors inherent in real acquisitions, with a sweet spot typically emerging at intermediate capacity.

papers.title_en: WorldRecon: Generative Multi-View Mesh Reconstruction for Large-Scale 3D World
papers.authors: Mengchen Zhang, Yang Li, Chunshi Wang, Tong Wu, Chunchao Guo
papers.evidence: 从未标定多视图图像恢复大型场景网格
papers.tldr: 从无位姿多视角图像重建大规模场景时，视角稀疏且全局几何噪声会导致网格缺失、细节不足和区域不连贯。WorldRecon利用重建模型估计的相机位姿与粗糙全局点云搭建空间支架，划分重叠区块，并以TRELLIS.2结合局部点云和相关图像逐块生成几何与材质。邻域感知潜变量修补和因果式生成传递区块间的结构、几何及材质上下文。在合成与真实室内场景中，Chamfer距离分别降低14.9%和43.1%，F-score分别提升17.3%和12.0%。该方法实现更完整连贯的大场景网格重建，并展现较强的仿真到真实泛化能力。
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing complete, high-quality meshes of large-scale scenes from unposed multi-view images requires faithful geometric grounding while plausibly completing surfaces that are unobserved or only sparsely captured. We present WorldRecon, a generative multi-view reconstruction framework for recovering complete, large-scale 3D scene meshes from unposed RGB images. WorldRecon uses a coarse, noisy global point cloud and camera poses estimated from the input images by a reconstruction model as a global scaffold for whole-scene generation and partitions it into overlapping spatial blocks. To robustly leverage these imperfect geometric priors, we equip the native 3D generative model TRELLIS.2 with a dedicated reconstruction-based conditioning architecture that generates each block from its local point-cloud crop and block-relevant image observations, producing sparse structure, detailed geometry, and PBR materials. To maintain scene-level coherence, we introduce neighbour-aware latent inpainting and a causal world-generation procedure that propagates structural, geometric, and material context across overlapping blocks. Together, these designs scale multi-view generative reconstruction to large-scale scenes, yielding coherent, unified meshes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that WorldRecon achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction performance, reducing Chamfer distance by 14.9% and 43.1% while improving F-score by 17.3% and 12.0% over the strongest baselines on synthetic and real-world indoor scenes, respectively, thereby demonstrating faithful and complete generative reconstruction as well as strong sim-to-real generalization. Project page: https://kszpxxzmc.github.io/WorldRecon-website/.

papers.title_en: Building Rome from a Single Image
papers.authors: Jiraphon Yenphraphai, Fang Li, Tianshuo Xu, Depu Meng, Quentin Herau, Yihan Hu, Raymond A. Yeh, Wei Zhan
papers.evidence: 单图生成室内外场景网格，并按距离自适应分块保留多尺度细节
papers.tldr: 从单张图像生成完整三维场景，难点在于补全相机未观测区域，而现有预训练生成器偏向固定空间中的单体物体，户外数据也不足。本文改造 Trellis 2，以自适应区块表示场景：近处保留细节，远处建筑采用较大区块；同时提升图像特征，明确编码空间、可见表面与未知区域。作者还合成约四千个户外场景扩充训练数据。在坦克与寺庙、ScanNet++及真实野外图像上，方法在几何准确度和感知质量上均胜过基线，拓展了生成器对室内外场景的适用性。
papers.abstract_en: Single-image scene generation aims to produce a complete 3D scene mesh from a single image, including surfaces the camera did not observe. While pretrained 3D object generators encode a strong shape prior, they are mainly designed for isolated objects in a fixed canonical volume and focus mostly on indoor scenes, since diverse 3D data for outdoor scenes are quite limited. In this work, we present a method that redesigns such an object-centric generator, e.g., Trellis 2, to work on both indoor and outdoor scenes while retaining its prior. We accomplish this by (a) partitioning the scene into adaptive chunks that scale relative to the distance to the camera; nearby chunks have a smaller size to keep the finer detail, while distant structures, e.g., buildings, are covered by large chunks; (b) making the generator capture explicit 2D-3D correspondence by lifting image features and making the model aware of the free space, observed surface, and unobserved region; (c) synthesizing around 4,000 outdoor scenes to broaden the training data, as existing scene datasets are largely indoor. Experiments on Tanks and Temples, ScanNet++, and in-the-wild images show that our method outperforms all baselines in geometric accuracy and perceptual quality across both indoor and outdoor scenes.

papers.title_en: GUARD: Geometric Uncertainty-Aware Point Cloud Denoising and Segmentation for Robotic Hard Disk Drive Disassembly
papers.authors: Zuoxu Wang, Xiao Liang
papers.evidence: 单次前向处理中执行几何不确定性感知点云去噪与分割
papers.tldr: 机器人拆解硬盘需要可靠地区分真实部件与扫描重建伪影；结构化重影可能局部像真实部件，语义置信度却不能证明其几何可靠。GUARD将点过滤与分割整合进单次前向计算，以多尺度几何特征和高斯过程估计逐点几何不确定性，并结合预测熵抑制不可靠测量。测试2745个真实硬盘点云时，PointNet++平均交并比从0.7739提升至0.8318；ScanNet污染点检测中，几何不确定性F1为0.7931，显著高于预测熵的0.2212。结果显示，几何可靠性评估能改善部件识别与后续机器人操作，同时须权衡伪影抑制和有效结构保留。
papers.abstract_en: Reliable robotic disassembly requires part-level representations that distinguish genuine component geometry from scanning and reconstruction artifacts. In point clouds of hard disk drives (HDDs), structured ghost artifacts can resemble valid components locally while remaining inconsistent with the overall geometry, allowing erroneous measurements to receive plausible semantic labels. This creates an engineering information problem: semantic prediction confidence alone does not establish whether the underlying geometry is reliable. We propose \textbf{GUARD}, a geometric uncertainty-aware framework that performs point filtering and segmentation within a single forward pass by modeling the reliability of learned geometric representations. GUARD combines a multi-scale geometric transformer with a multi-bandwidth random Fourier feature Gaussian Process to estimate per-point geometric uncertainty, complemented by predictive entropy to suppress unreliable measurements while preserving informative structures. Evaluation on 2,745 real HDD point clouds shows that GUARD improves PointNet++ segmentation mean intersection over union from 0.7739 to 0.8318. Additional experiments on ShapeNetPart and ScanNet examine robustness across corruption types, point-cloud domains, and segmentation backbones. On manually annotated ScanNet samples, geometric uncertainty achieves a corrupted-point detection F1 score of 0.7931, compared with 0.2212 for predictive entropy. The results demonstrate the value of distinguishing geometric reliability from semantic confidence and reveal a tradeoff between artifact suppression and preservation of informative structures. GUARD contributes a reliability-aware approach to interpreting imperfect 3D measurements for component identification and subsequent robotic handling. Project website: https://001-wang.github.io/GUARD_Point_denoiser/.

papers.title_en: PCAsplat: Gaussian Splatting with Local PCA Regularization
papers.authors: Vitor Matias, Filipe Nascimento, Kiyohiro Nakayama, João Paulo Lima, Márcus Lobo, Gordon Wetzstein, Leonidas Guibas, Afonso Paiva, Tiago Novello
papers.evidence: 为高斯泼溅三维重建加入局部几何正则化
papers.tldr: 高斯泼溅主要依赖光栅化损失，遮挡或对当前视角贡献较小的高斯缺少几何监督，可能偏离真实表面并形成浮点伪影。PCAsplat在高斯中心邻域上实施可微局部PCA，约束特征值以促使高斯贴近表面并覆盖切平面，同时对齐高斯法线与邻域法线。在DTU、Tanks and Temples和NeRF Synthetic上，该方法改善表面贴合度并显著减少浮点伪影。所得表示还支持点云分割与直接泊松重建，并在新视角合成和网格提取中保持竞争力。
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian splatting has emerged as a flexible representation for 3D reconstruction from posed images. However, existing methods are optimized primarily using rasterization-based losses, which supervise a splat only when it contributes to sampled camera rays. Gaussians that are occluded or contribute little to the sampled view therefore receive weak or no geometric gradients and may drift away from the underlying surface, producing undesired floaters. We introduce PCAsplat, a geometry-aware regularization framework for Gaussian splatting based on differentiable local principal component analysis (PCA). Our PCA regularizer acts directly on neighborhoods of Gaussian centers and can therefore update Gaussians that do not contribute to the current training view. We regularize the PCA eigenvalues to encourage Gaussians to move to the underlying surface with isotropic tangent-plane coverage. We also align each Gaussian normal with the PCA-estimated neighborhood normal to enforce consistent orientation. Experiments on DTU, Tanks and Temples, and NeRF Synthetic show that the splats produced by PCAsplat better approximate samples of the reference surface while substantially reducing undesired floaters. These surface-aligned splats enable downstream geometry-processing tasks, including point cloud segmentation, and direct Poisson reconstruction. Additionally, PCAsplat remains competitive under conventional novel view synthesis and mesh extraction tasks. Code will be released.

papers.title_en: 3DTexMOR: 3D Gaussian Multi-Object Removal via Texture-Space Inpainting
papers.authors: Kunxin Guang, Yonghao Zhao, Jian Yang, Beibei Wang
papers.evidence: 通过跨视角纹理空间补全重建场景中的遮挡区域
papers.tldr: 多目标遮挡场景中，单视图可见上下文有限，逐视图二维修补容易产生伪影；不同视角的补全不一致，还会造成冲突监督与模糊重建。3DTexMOR将多视角观测融合到共享纹理空间，修补视图无关的内禀属性，再投影回相机视图监督高斯场景补全，并以几何正则约束缺失区域。实验显示其较现有方法提升PSNR 5.8 dB、LPIPS至少降低22%，取得多目标移除领先效果。该方法借助跨视角互补信息增强外观一致性与几何可信度，为复杂场景三维对象移除提供有效方案。
papers.abstract_en: 3D object removal aims to remove target objects from reconstructed scenes and complete the geometry and appearance of occluded regions. Existing NeRF- and 3DGS-based methods typically inpaint 2D images to guide 3D completion. However, complex multi-object layouts limit the surrounding context visible in each view, making 2D inpainting prone to artifacts. Inconsistent completions across views also introduce conflicting supervision and blurry reconstructions. We propose 3D Gaussian Multi-Object Removal via Texture-Space Inpainting (3DTexMOR). Our key idea is to perform inpainting in a unified texture space shared by all views. By combining complementary observations, this space provides richer context for recovering missing regions and promotes cross-view appearance consistency. We aggregate multi-view observations into texture maps, inpaint the missing regions, and reproject the completed maps into camera views to supervise Gaussian scene completion. To avoid the influence of view-dependent highlights and reflections, we decompose appearance and aggregate view-independent intrinsic attributes instead of RGB colors. We further introduce geometrically regularized Gaussian completion to constrain the geometry of the completed regions. Extensive experiments demonstrate visually plausible completions and state-of-the-art multi-object removal performance, improving PSNR by 5.8 dB and reducing LPIPS by at least 22% compared with existing methods.

papers.title_en: GATOR: Generative and Agentic 3D Object Reconstruction From Casual Images
papers.authors: Qirui Wu, Stan Birchfield, Hesam Rabeti, Angel X. Chang, Bowen Wen
papers.evidence: 从随手拍摄图像生成完整三维对象，并恢复场景相对位姿
papers.tldr: 从随手拍图像重建完整三维物体，既要应对视角稀疏和遮挡，也要区分目标与环境并确定场景相对位姿。GATOR先融合图像、目标掩码和点图等空间线索，再用类别名称与描述文本引导结构、几何和外观生成。生成资产随后交给多模态智能体，通过观察、编辑、渲染和复核循环定向修正结构与纹理。在合成物体、杂乱桌面及室内场景中，方法取得较强几何与外观保真度，并支持稀疏视角下的位姿恢复。时间预算比较和场景级仿真进一步表明其重建效率与仿真应用潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing complete, scene-aligned 3D objects from casual images requires integrating sparse, uncertain observations and inferring surfaces hidden by occlusions. We present GATOR, a generative and agentic framework that recovers textured object assets and their scene-relative pose from one or more images. Our local modality mixer couples patch-aligned RGB, target-mask, and pointmap features before cross-view reasoning, preserving scene context while distinguishing the target from its surroundings. Text-guided semantic conditioning complements these spatial cues with category names and object captions through stage-specific adapters for structure, geometry, and appearance generation. The generated asset initializes a multimodal agent, providing instance-specific geometry and pose for targeted structural and texture refinement through an observation-guided edit-render-review loop. Across synthetic objects, cluttered tabletops, and indoor scenes, GATOR achieves strong geometric and appearance fidelity while recovering scene-relative pose from sparse observations. Time-budget comparisons and scene-level simulation further demonstrate the reconstruction efficiency and simulation readiness. Project page: https://research.nvidia.com/labs/lpr/gator/

papers.title_en: PrimitiveCAD: An LLM-Based Point-to-CAD Reconstruction with Primitive-Aware Tokenization and Operation Alignment
papers.authors: Jian Gao, Kailin Bi, Jiamin Xu, Jinlan Xu, Gang Xu
papers.evidence: 由点云重建几何精确的CAD模型，属于三维重建方法
papers.tldr: 点云到CAD生成有望提升工业设计和三维建模效率，但通用点云表示与令牌预测难以捕捉CAD原语结构，复杂形状及关键特征常重建不准。PrimitiveCAD采用多阶段方案：以原语感知点云令牌化学习几何表示，再微调大语言模型，并用操作对齐损失约束CAD操作频率。随后通过强化学习和特征线对齐奖励降低生成随机性，细化几何特征。该方法在DeepCAD与Fusion360上实现代码有效性、几何准确性和特征保留的当前最佳表现，为CAD专用的点云重建提供了有效路径。
papers.abstract_en: Large-model-based point-to-CAD generation holds immense potential for advancing industrial design and enhancing 3D modeling efficiency. However, most existing methods approach the problem as a general point-cloud encoding and token prediction task, neglecting the tokenization and supervision specifically for CAD-related primitives. As a result, these methods often struggle to accurately reconstruct the intricate primitive structures. To address this limitation, we propose PrimitiveCAD, a novel multi-stage paradigm for point-to-CAD reconstruction that enhances the geometric accuracy of generated CAD models while better preserving critical geometric features. First, we introduce a primitive-aware point cloud tokenization model, enabling the system to learn more robust geometric representations from CAD point clouds. Next, we perform supervised finetuning on a large language model (LLM) and introduce an operation alignment loss to align key CAD operation frequencies, thereby improving the preservation of global shape features. Finally, we incorporate reinforcement learning (RL) and introduce a feature-line alignment reward to further reduce stochasticity and enhance the fine-grained preservation of geometric features. Experiments on the DeepCAD and Fusion360 datasets show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in code validity, geometric accuracy, and geometric feature preservation.

papers.title_en: IntrinSync: Joint Intrinsic Decomposition and Reciprocal Rendering
papers.authors: Zheng Gu, Rui Huang, Xilu Zhang, Jingbo Zhang, Min Lu, Zhida Sun, Dani Lischinski, Daniel Cohen-Or, Hui Huang
papers.evidence: 从图像联合分解材质相关属性、光照与表面法线
papers.tldr: 逆向渲染需从图像恢复反照率、光照等内在属性，但这些通道彼此依赖；孤立预测或将逆向与正向渲染分开处理，容易得到无法共同解释原图的结果。IntrinSync通过联合通道生成，同时预测反照率、阴影、表面法线、粗糙度和金属度，并以双向循环一致目标连接分解与渲染。三个数据集实验显示，该方法的内在属性估计和正向渲染均具竞争力，且提升了结果间的协调性与物理一致性。它还支持显式编辑内在属性并重新渲染，为物理约束的图像编辑提供接口。
papers.abstract_en: Inverse rendering decomposes an image into intrinsic properties such as appearance, illumination, geometry, and material, yet these properties are inherently interdependent. A reliable decomposition should produce intrinsic maps that are not only individually plausible, but also mutually compatible in explaining the image. However, existing methods either model intrinsic channels in isolation or treat inverse and forward rendering as separate processes, leaving the interdependence underexploited. In this paper, we introduce IntrinSync, a unified framework that captures this interdependence through joint-channel modeling and reciprocal inverse-forward rendering. At the channel level, we jointly decompose an input RGB into albedo, shading, surface normal, roughness, and metallic maps through a 1-to-N mapping, enabling information exchange across channels throughout generation. At the process level, we establish inverse-forward reciprocity through a dual cycle-consistent objective that aligns corresponding predictions across a closed loop. Experiments on three datasets demonstrate that our method achieves competitive intrinsic estimation and forward rendering performance, improving coherence and physical consistency. Beyond decomposition, IntrinSync provides a physically grounded interface for image editing, allowing intrinsic properties to be explicitly manipulated and rendered back into RGB images.

papers.title_en: Pumpire: Unified Benchmark for Metric Distance Estimation
papers.authors: Siyu Chen, Zehan Wang, Jiayang Xu, Yihan Wu, Jialei Wang, Junming Chen, Ziang Zhang, Yutong Ying, Zhou Zhao
papers.evidence: 为图像与视频三维基础模型的重建几何提供点间距离评测基准
papers.tldr: 三维重建评测常关注深度、相机内参或点云几何相似度，却不能直接回答模型能否恢复真实世界中的点间距离。为此，论文提出Pumpire统一基准，收集100个真实场景、共6400帧，并为点对距离提供物理实测标注。基准设计统一协议，覆盖图像级和视频级三维基础模型，也支持比较有无深度先验的设置；研究据此评测29种模型配置并进行综合分析。Pumpire将评测推进到重建空间的物理尺度感知，为衡量模型的距离估计能力提供直接、可比较的工具。
papers.abstract_en: We present Pumpire, a unified benchmark for evaluating metric point-pair distance estimation capability of both image- and video-level 3D foundation models, with or without depth priors. In contrast to previous approaches that normally evaluate depth and camera intrinsics separately or evaluate point-clouds with geometric similarity metrics, which cannot directly reflect models' point-to-point distance estimation capability, Pumpire directly assesses point-to-point distances from the reconstructed geometry. To this end, we collect a large-scale and diverse dataset (pumpire-6k) comprising 100 real-world scenes, each annotated with physically measured point-pair distances and containing 64 frames, for a total of 6,400 frames. Building on this dataset, we establish a holistic evaluation protocol that covers both image- and video-level 3D foundation models and enables direct assessment of point-pair distance errors and cross-setting comparison. We conduct extensive experiments across 29 baseline configurations of representative 3D foundation models and provide a comprehensive analysis of the results. By offering this benchmark, we target the more fundamental ability to perceive and estimate physical scale in the reconstructed 3D space, which prior evaluation protocols have largely overlooked. The project page can be found at https://pumpire.github.io/

papers.title_en: Efficient Confidence-Aware Densification for 3DGS
papers.authors: Manuel Hofer, Thomas Köhler, Felix Windisch, Bernhard Kerbl, Markus Steinberger, Lukas Radl
papers.evidence: 改进3D高斯溅射的增密策略，属于三维场景重建方法的改进。
papers.tldr: 固定预算增密中，3DGS-MCMC依据不透明度采样，常把新高斯放到已重建良好的前景，使背景误差难以修复；低预算先验方法虽有效，却依赖预训练辐射场或密集图像匹配及额外初始化。本文提出置信度感知增密，在保持固定预算与渐进增长的同时，依据图像误差和屏幕空间梯度选取位置，并将低贡献高斯迁移至低置信区域。24个场景实验显示，100k至2M预算下均优于MCMC；500k起PSNR和SSIM领先所比较的固定预算方法，且无需先验即可提升低预算质量。该方案兼顾误差驱动增密、固定预算效率与先验可选性。
papers.abstract_en: 3DGS-MCMC has replaced the gradient-driven density control of 3D Gaussian Splatting with opacity-based sampling and relocation, and is now the de facto standard for prior-free densification under a fixed primitive budget. Because opacity stays high where the scene is already well reconstructed, this sampling sends most new primitives to the foreground and leaves the background under-reconstructed. At low budgets, prior-based methods such as ConeGS and EDGS outperform it, at the cost of a pre-trained radiance field or dense image matches and a separate initialization stage. We argue for a comeback of error-driven densification within the fixed-budget MCMC framework. Our confidence-aware densification keeps the fixed budget and gradual growth of 3DGS-MCMC, but places primitives by the image error instead of the opacity. New primitives are drawn mostly where screen-space gradients are large. We favor primitives with a low learned confidence, which marks regions the reconstruction still explains poorly, and relocate the primitives that contribute least to the rendered images to these places. Averaged over 24 scenes, our method outperforms 3DGS-MCMC in PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS at every budget from 100k to 2M primitives. At 100k, without a prior or an initialization stage, it recovers 0.84dB of the 1.05dB PSNR by which ConeGS leads 3DGS-MCMC, and from 500k on, it has the highest PSNR and SSIM of all fixed-budget methods we compare with, including ConeGS and EDGS. While inherently prior-free, our densification can also exploit priors: from the ConeGS or EDGS initialization, it matches ConeGS in PSNR and SSIM at 100k and is best in all three metrics at 500k.

papers.title_en: HorizonNav: Geometry-Guided Video Diffusion for Anticipatory 3D Robot Navigation
papers.authors: Hajira Amjad, Valerii Serpiva, Viacheslav Liubimov, Didar Seyidov, Dzmitry Tsetserukou
papers.evidence: 结合单目深度与相机位姿估计生成几何对齐的三维空间表示
papers.tldr: 机器人依据单张 RGB 图像导航时，视野外空间未知，而生成视频的时间连贯性并不能保证三维几何一致，可能误导规划。HorizonNav 将图像与文本提示交给视觉语言模型和视频扩散模型，生成可能的未来观测，再结合 ORB-SLAM3 位姿、稠密深度与三角化地标进行跨视角深度对齐。19 个场景中可规划场景从 13 个增至 15 个，RRT 成功试验从 62/90 增至 75/90，走廊结构地标平均误差约 0.30 米。该方法为无激光雷达条件下的前瞻导航提供几何引导的环境重建，同时揭示重建及自由空间判断仍会失败。
papers.abstract_en: We present HorizonNav, a video diffusion-based framework for anticipatory robot navigation that transforms a single RGB image and a text prompt into a geometrically aligned representation of plausible surrounding 3D space. Given the initial observation and a textual description of the reconstruction objective, a vision-language model, guided by designed instructions, interprets the scene and constructs structured prompts for a video diffusion model. The resulting video sequence provides plausible future observations of the environment, which are subsequently processed using monocular ORB-SLAM3 for camera pose estimation and Video Depth Anything for dense depth prediction. Our central contribution is a geometry-guided depth alignment stage that combines the estimated camera poses with triangulated visual landmarks to constrain dense depth predictions across multiple views. This alignment improves the geometric consistency of the reconstructed 3D environment, addressing inconsistencies that temporal coherence of the generated video alone cannot resolve. The experimental evaluation of navigation in imagined 3D environment shows that across a 19-scene horizon study, planning-feasible scenes increase from 13/19 at P20 to 15/19 at P81, while successful RRT trials increase from 62/90 to 75/90. In a separate corridor study, 6 of 25 evaluable generated-camera trajectories violate the reconstructed collision constraints; RRT planner recovers feasible alternatives in 5 of those 6 cases. A larger archive contains 58 usable reconstructions from 67 attempted cases, of which 36 support a downstream plan and 22 do not, exposing reconstruction and free-space failure modes rather than hiding them without lidar. Across 15 corridor reconstructions, the mean reconstruction error is approximately 0.30 m at matched structural landmarks.

papers.title_en: Geometry-Constrained Bidirectional Point Cloud Registration for Thin, Sheet-Like Heritage Artifacts
papers.authors: Yuezhe Zhang, Lei Wei, Jingnan Du, Shuai Wan
papers.evidence: 对独立采集的正反面点云进行几何约束配准，服务于三维重建。
papers.tldr: 薄片状文物易碎且无法悬挂或粘贴标记，通常需分别采集正反面；两面共同几何特征有限，使配准易受旋转歧义、优化不稳定和结构塌陷影响。本文提出几何约束的双向点云配准方法，先做语义引导预处理与主成分分析归一化，再将估计厚度纳入配准约束，并评估多个整体旋转假设、以点到平面迭代最近点细化。实验表明，该方法多数情况下性能有竞争力或更优，尤其改善投影面积一致性和正反面物理对齐。厚度约束与旋转假设筛选还可避免表面错误翻转却得分看似合理的退化结果，为脆弱薄片文物的可靠非接触数字化提供支持。
papers.abstract_en: Non-contact three-dimensional reconstruction of thin, sheet-like heritage artifacts poses significant geometric and registration challenges. Due to their fragility, these artifacts cannot be suspended or equipped with artificial markers, necessitating independent acquisition of their front and back surfaces. Subsequent registration proves difficult due to the limited number of shared geometric features and the scarcity of explicit physical constraints, which may result in rotational ambiguity, instability, and structural collapse during iterative optimization. To address these challenges, we propose a geometry-constrained bidirectional point cloud registration method specifically tailored for thin, sheet-like heritage artifacts. The method integrates semantic-guided preprocessing, Principal Component Analysis (PCA)-based geometric normalization, and a thickness-aware registration strategy. The estimated physical thickness is incorporated as a geometric constraint to preserve structural integrity during registration. Rotational ambiguity is resolved by evaluating a finite set of global rotation hypotheses, each refined using the point-to-plane Iterative Closest Point (ICP) algorithm, with the optimal transformation selected via a geometry-aware fitness criterion consistent with the thickness scale. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves competitive or improved performance in most cases, particularly in projected area consistency and physically plausible front-back alignment. In addition, the thickness-aware constraint and rotation hypothesis evaluation reduce the risk of degenerate configurations in which the two surfaces are incorrectly flipped while still yielding deceptively acceptable numerical scores, supporting reliable non-contact digitization of delicate and thin heritage artifacts. Implementation details are available at https://zyz-nwpu.github.io/GCBPCR/.

papers.title_en: PIE-PS: Photometric Stereo from Physical Irradiance Event Streams
papers.authors: Xiangze Meng, Guangyu Li, Jing Li, Di Mei, Songchen Ma, Mingkun Xu, Rui Ma
papers.evidence: 从事件流和已知照明学习稠密表面法线
papers.tldr: 事件相机以微秒级延迟记录光照变化、动态范围高，适用于移动光源下的光度立体；但事件稀疏且依赖未知触发阈值，使稠密法线重建困难。论文从事件触发模型推导物理关系，并将同一像素相邻事件与光照方向配对，构造无需阈值的带符号事件率特征。PIE-GNN以图结构整合时空邻域信息，可靠性分级注意力则降低低可信观测的影响，再聚合得到稠密法线。合成与真实数据实验显示，该方法优于既有事件光度立体方法和直接求解器，为利用原始事件流进行稳健三维形状估计提供了新方案。
papers.abstract_en: Event cameras record asynchronous log-image-irradiance changes with microsecond latency and high dynamic range. These properties are useful for photometric stereo under moving illumination, but raw events are sparse and depend on an unknown contrast threshold. We start from the event trigger model and derive a physical relation between adjacent events, light motion, and surface normals. This relation gives a direct physics-only solver, but the solver needs the threshold, enough events at each pixel, and independent per-pixel optimization. To address these limits, we introduce PIE-PS, a learning-based framework for dense surface normal reconstruction from raw event streams and known lighting. We form Physical Irradiance Events (PIEs) by pairing two adjacent events at the same pixel with their corresponding light directions. Each PIE provides a Physical Irradiance Event Feature (PIEF), defined as the signed event rate. PIEF does not require the unknown contrast threshold. To share spatial and temporal context across nearby PIEs, we introduce PIE-GNN, which treats each PIE as a graph node and encodes it with its light-pair geometry. Since the reliability of PIE observations can vary with local appearance, illumination geometry, and sensor noise, Reliability-Grading Attention (RGA) predicts reliability weights to down-weight unreliable PIEs. Pixel aggregation then produces dense normals. Experiments on synthetic and real data show that PIE-PS outperforms prior event-based photometric stereo methods and the direct solver baseline.

papers.title_en: Depth-to-RGB: Repurposing a Frozen Depth Estimator for Geometry-Guided Compositing
papers.authors: Sanghyun Jo, Chae Yeon Lim, Donghwan Lee, Sihyun Kim, Soo Ye Kim, Kyungsu Kim
papers.evidence: 利用冻结深度估计器预测合成场景深度以辅助几何引导合成
papers.tldr: 参考式物体合成依赖背景、参考图和二维掩码控制外观与位置，但几何仍隐含，可能造成结构失真或环境变化。D2R冻结深度估计器解码器，学习参考条件下的编码特征修正，并以预测深度固定渲染来指导图像生成。特征监督使域外阶段一绝对相对误差较解码深度监督降低31.4%；类别无关测试中误差较匹配RGB基线降低43.7%，峰值信噪比提高2.4分。该方法还在配对与非配对基准上表现领先，为合成提供了有效的几何约束。
papers.abstract_en: Reference-based object compositing inserts or replaces an object using a background image, a reference image, and a 2D compositing mask. These inputs guide appearance and placement but leave the completed scene's geometry implicit, which can distort object structure or alter the surroundings. Our Depth-to-RGB (D2R) framework predicts composite depth for a scene not yet observed in the RGB inputs. It learns reference-conditioned corrections to a frozen depth estimator using encoder features of paired completed scenes as targets. The unchanged decoder maps the corrected representation to the intended scene's depth, which a separately trained renderer holds fixed during RGB synthesis. Under matched architecture and training, encoder-feature supervision reduces OOD Stage-1 AbsRel by 31.4% relative to decoded-depth supervision. We also introduce AnyInsertion++ with paired in-distribution and category-disjoint splits to evaluate generalization beyond compositing training categories. The complete D2R system leads 12 open-source and 3 closed-source baselines in estimator-derived geometry and photometric quality on both paired splits. On category-disjoint data, D2R reduces AbsRel by 43.7% and improves PSNR by 2.4 dB over the matched RGB baseline. Across three unpaired benchmarks, D2R leads both identity metrics and reduces mean CLIP reference cosine distance by 55% relative to the strongest baseline. Project page: https://shjo-april.github.io/Depth2RGB/

papers.title_en: CADFather: Autonomous CAD Reconstruction through Coordinated Tool Use
papers.authors: Gennadiy Savrasov, Maksim Elistratov, Nikita Gavrilov, Albert Garifullin, Oleg Pavlov, Soslan Kabisov, Vladimir Frolov, Anton Konushin, Andrey Kuznetsov, Dmitrii Zhemchuzhnikov
papers.evidence: 从三维网格重建参数化CAD模型，与三维形状重建方法相关
papers.tldr: 从三维网格恢复可编辑、参数化CAD模型仍具挑战，单一操作提案来源难以适配不同零件几何及重建阶段。CADFather由视觉语言助手检查目标和中间重建结果，并协调学习式与算法式工具生成操作提案、数值优化参数，再利用程序执行反馈指导后续决策。系统为每个零件维护多个候选程序，并在重建过程中保留最佳有效结果，且不需额外训练预训练模型。在多个公开基准上评估重建质量、执行有效性与计算成本，并分析成本和质量的权衡，为自主CAD重建提供协同工具方案。
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing an editable CAD model from a 3D shape remains a challenging engineering task. Existing methods can propose CAD operations, but no single source of proposals works equally well across different part geometries and stages of reconstruction. We introduce CADFather, an autonomous agentic system that coordinates complementary tools to recover parametric CAD programs from 3D meshes. A vision-language assistant inspects renders of the target and intermediate reconstructions, then decides which candidate CAD programs to extend, which tools to invoke, how many proposals to generate, and when to finish. Learned and algorithmic tools propose CAD operations, while numerical optimization refines the parameters of existing programs. Proposed or refined programs are executed and evaluated to provide feedback for subsequent decisions. The agent maintains alternative candidate programs for each target part and preserves the best valid result throughout reconstruction. CADFather uses pretrained generation and assistant models without additional training. We evaluate reconstruction quality and execution validity on the full DeepCAD, Fusion360, and MCB test sets, as well as on CADENA-Bench, CADBench, and BenchCAD. We additionally analyze computational cost and the trade-off between cost and reconstruction quality.

papers.title_en: OmniCam: Omni-Camera Trajectory Generation via Geometry-Grounded Pose Token Learning
papers.authors: Zhenyang Liu, Chenjie Cao, Yisu Zhang, Xuhui Zuo, Xiangyang Xue, Yanwei Fu, Tengfei Wang, Chunchao Guo
papers.evidence: 从全景图生成几何约束的相机位姿序列
papers.tldr: 视频生成、场景重建和机器人感知都需要合适的相机运动，而依据语言生成轨迹还必须兼顾场景几何与目标取景。OmniCam从单张全景图和轨迹描述出发，以全景点云表示环境，结合旋转与平移姿态标记、几何和语义条件及三维目标锚点，自回归生成相机序列。团队构建了涵盖四类行为、共267,700条轨迹的OmniCaT；评测显示，相较在该数据集重训的GenDoP，误差降低28%至47%，碰撞率降低65.8%。消融实验支持几何与目标条件设计，后续实验还考察视频生成及机器人主动感知中的应用价值。
papers.abstract_en: Camera trajectories control viewpoint changes in video generation, scene reconstruction, and robotic perception. Generating them from language requires both scene geometry and target-aware framing. We introduce OmniCam, an autoregressive model that generates camera pose sequences from a single panorama and textual trajectory descriptions. Its geometry-grounded pose token learning combines three components: a panoramic point-cloud encoder for omnidirectional geometric context; hybrid absolute-rotation and relative-translation tokenization with temporally consistent quaternion signs; and separate geometric and semantic conditioning streams with an explicit 3D target anchor. We also construct OmniCaT, containing 267,700 trajectories across four camera behaviors. On the reported OmniCaT evaluation, OmniCam reduces trajectory errors by 28--47% and collision rate by 65.8% relative to GenDoP retrained on OmniCaT. Against the best baseline for each metric, the ATE and collision reductions are 43.0% and 62.3%, respectively. Component ablations support the use of geometric and target-aware conditioning, while downstream experiments examine camera-controlled video generation and robotic active perception.
